map.依次呈现数字或图形序列（可设速度与长度），消失后要求按原序复现；错一处即结束并记: A sequence of digits or figures is presented one by one (speed and length are adjustable); after it disappears you must reproduce it in the original order; a single error ends the round and the length reached is recorded. …
map.顺序记忆：依次显示/播放序列，要求原样复现。: Sequential memory: show or play a sequence and require it to be reproduced exactly.
map.长度速度可调：逐步加长、加快，挑战工作记忆。: Sequence speed is adjustable: lengthen and speed it up step by step to challenge working memory.
map.脑力训练：记录达成长度。: Brain training: record the length reached.
map.和 color-memory 区别？: How is it different from color-memory?
map.规则同属序列记忆；本工具序列可为数字/符号，color-memory 固定颜色序: The rule is the same as in sequence memory; here the sequence can be digits or symbols, while color-memory is fixed to colour sequences.
map.怎么记更长？: How do I remember longer sequences?
map.给序列编故事/分组，比逐位硬记容量更大。: Building a story or grouping the items holds far more than memorising digit by digit.
